28. a) Neil J. Mikoliczak 
b) 5368 South 24th Street
c) Private Citizen
d) 128
e) Stated that the Airport Spur isn't necessary and thinks the roads we have are capable of handling the traffic.
f) The local street system is capable of handling airport traffic.
g) The local streets are capable of handling present day traffic but will not be unable to handle the increased airport oriented traffic efficiently or safely.
29. a) Edgar P. Vie 
c) Chief of the Airport District
Office of the Federal Aviation
Administration in Minneapolis
d) 129
e) Spoke for FAA Regional Director
John Surocke and the Chief of Airport
Division in Chicago, Louis Million, who
are in favor of the Airport Spur.
f) Stated FAA asked in early 1960 that a spur be constructed to aid in the future development of General Mitchell Field. FAA is partially financing Master Plan to determine the future of General Mitchell Field.
The Master Plan prepared by Milwaukee County Department of Public Works and Airport Consultant calling for a 90 million dollar expenditure in the next 20 years to expand and modernize Mitchell Field was backed in October 1974 by Milwaukee County Board's Transportation and Public Works Committee.
The Transportation and Public Works Committee is presently negotiating with an architectural firm to design a 1 million dollar customs building to enable Mitchell Field to handle international fights. They are also in the process of retaining a consultant to design a planned parking structure.
